notes: Black Friday letter/notice statics from 5 user-supplied format references (2026-10-27): urgent notice, 'did we mess up' founder note, final hours, saying goodbye, formal apology. Lead offer is EITHER 60% OFF SITEWIDE (L48_01, 03, 05) OR buy 2 pairs + free socks and travel bag (L48_02, 04); free shipping & returns and the 30-day money-back guarantee as small supporting lines. Signed 'The ComfortWear Team' (no founder name given). The notice is signed by ComfortWear, not a made-up institute. Text sized for readers 60+. v2 round 2026-10-27: user edits on L48_01/02/04/05 plus general foot-pain versions L48_06 (of 01) and L48_07 (of 03).

concepts.angle: Urgent public-notice format, signed by the brand: the everyday foot problems customers report, then ComfortWear as the answer, then the Black Friday line in red
concepts.based_on: User reference 'Communiqué du centre français de l'hygiène intime' (urgent notice format) + survey problems (heel pain 25%, swelling, toe room) + copy playbook rule 1 (who + pain with a number)
concepts.headline: A NOTICE FROM THE COMFORTWEAR TEAM.
concepts.prompt: Plain white tall background, like a typed public notice. Upper-middle, a large yellow warning triangle icon with a black exclamation mark. Below it, centered, a bold black all-caps title on two lines: "A NOTICE FROM THE" and "COMFORTWEAR TEAM." Then left-aligned paragraphs in a clean bold-ish black sans, large and easy to read, with a blank line between paragraphs. Paragraph 1: "Nurses and travelers keep telling us the same thing: " followed by an underlined phrase "heel pain by hour 6, swollen feet by dinner, and toes crushed in narrow sneakers." Paragraph 2: "What it costs: cut-short walks, ruined trips, limping to the car after a 12-hour shift." Paragraph 3: "For anyone dealing with this, there is a comfortable answer: ComfortWear. Real arch support, a wide toe box and stretch knit that gives when feet swell." Paragraph 4 in bold red: "BLACK FRIDAY: 60% OFF SITEWIDE." Nothing else on the image.
concepts.revision: v2 (user 2026-10-27): only 'BLACK FRIDAY: 60% OFF SITEWIDE.' as the offer line; free shipping & returns removed.

concepts.angle: 'Uh-oh, did we mess up?' founder-style note: we were too generous with the buy-2 gifts; product quality as the reason it can't last
concepts.based_on: User reference 'Uh-oh... did we mess up?' (Onecompress founder note) + existing B48_05 'We miscalculated' angle + copy playbook rule 6 (arch that holds, wide toe box, cushion that doesn't go flat)
concepts.headline: UH-OH... DID WE MESS UP?
concepts.prompt: Soft pale mint-to-light-blue vertical gradient background. Top center, a big rounded friendly black display headline on two lines: "UH-OH... DID WE" and "MESS UP?" followed by a sweating-smile emoji 😅. Below, left-aligned short paragraphs in a clean dark sans, blank lines between them: "Hey there," / "We may have gotten a little too generous this Black Friday." / "Buy 2 pairs and you get 2 FREE gifts: a 3-pack of cushioned socks AND a travel bag." / "Here's the problem: these aren't cheap sneakers. Real arch support, a wide toe box, and a cushion that doesn't go flat by hour 4." / "So when the gifts are gone, they're gone." / "Free shipping & returns. 30-day money-back guarantee." / "Don't wait." / then on its own line "The ComfortWear Team". All body text is BIG for readers aged 60+: each body line about 1/24 of the image height (clearly larger than a normal letter), bold-ish weight, near-black, with the same even gap between every paragraph (no uneven or cramped spacing). Bottom-right corner, a natural photo of ONE PAIR (two shoes, left and right, side by side) of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, at true proportions, about one third of the image width, with a soft shadow. No socks, no bag, no other objects.
concepts.revision: v2 (user 2026-10-27): bigger body text, even paragraph spacing, only a pair of shoes (no socks or travel bag).

concepts.headline: BLACK FRIDAY FINAL HOURS
concepts.prompt: Dark charcoal background with a soft vignette. Top, a bold red all-caps headline with a red siren emoji 🚨 on each side: "BLACK FRIDAY FINAL HOURS". Below, left-aligned paragraphs in clean white sans, large and easy to read, with the named phrases in bold white: Paragraph 1: "Our " + bold "60% OFF SITEWIDE" + " Black Friday sale ends soon. This might be your last chance this year." Paragraph 2: "Why do nurses order 2, 3, even 4 pairs? concepts.headline: WE'RE SAYING GOODBYE
concepts.prompt: Clean white background. Top, a very large bold red all-caps headline across the width: "WE'RE SAYING GOODBYE". Below, two left-aligned paragraphs in bold-ish black sans, large and easy to read. Paragraph 1: "At ComfortWear, we believe women shouldn't have to choose between cute and comfortable. Say goodbye to heel pain, crushed toes and sneakers that give up by noon." Paragraph 2: "And say goodbye to our Black Friday gifts soon: " + bold "buy 2 pairs and get a FREE 3-pack of cushioned socks and a FREE travel bag." + " Free shipping & returns." Under that, a handwritten black signature reading "ComfortWear" and below it small black text "ComfortWear | Shoes for long days". Bottom third: a clean row on white with a pair of the navy shoes with bright blue accents from the product reference in the center, at true proportions and large, a rolled 3-pack of plain socks on the left, and on the right a LARGER zip travel bag, about as wide as the shoe pair and as tall as the shoes, with the ComfortWear logo from the attached logo image printed clearly on its front panel in its original navy color (the bag is light grey or off-white so the logo stands out).
concepts.revision: v2 (user 2026-10-27): travel bag bigger with the ComfortWear logo on it.

concepts.headline: A FORMAL APOLOGY FROM COMFORTWEAR
concepts.prompt: Plain white background like a printed letter. Top center, a bold black all-caps title on two lines: "A FORMAL APOLOGY FROM" and "COMFORTWEAR". Below, left-aligned short paragraphs in a clean black sans, blank lines between them: "Hi," / "We want to say sorry to everybody who reads this too late." / "Our biggest sale of the year is now live: " followed by the phrase in heavy BOLD "60% OFF SITEWIDE for Black Friday." (the only bold phrase in the body) / "We know many of you already bought a pair at full price this year. That's on us." / "The good news: if you haven't shopped yet, there's still time. Free shipping & returns, plus our 30-day money-back guarantee." / then in italics: "If you missed this by a day... we are genuinely sorry." At the bottom-left, a black handwritten signature reading "The ComfortWear Team" with a short line under it. All body text is BIG for readers aged 60+: each body line about 1/24 of the image height (clearly larger than a normal letter), bold-ish weight, near-black, with the same even gap between every paragraph (no uneven or cramped spacing). Nothing else on the image.
concepts.revision: v2 (user 2026-10-27): bigger body text; '60% OFF SITEWIDE for Black Friday' in bold.
